dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature along the trailing edge margin, exhibiting a smooth spline transition from apex to posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex classification with a non-acute pixel radius at the fin's highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Angular steepness of approximately 50 degrees relative to the longitudinal horizontal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.5:1 ratio of base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex arc with a large radius fitted to the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a thick pixel width relative to its extending length.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Measurable obtuse angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan-colored luminescent texture across the entire visible anatomy.
